title: 7 January 1964: Live: The Beatles' Christmas Show
content:
This was day 12 of The Beatles’ series of Christmas Shows, with performances to two houses at the Astoria Cinema in London’s Finsbury Park.

The first act on stage was the Barron Knights and Duke D’Mond. Next came short sets from Tommy Quickly and The Fourmost, and Billy J Kramer and The Dakotas closed the first half. Following the interval there was a return from the Barron Knights and Duke D’Mond, then Cilla Black, and Rolf Harris. The Beatles were the final act of each show, with a performance lasting just 25 minutes.

The group performed nine songs: ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘All My Loving’, ‘This Boy’, ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘Till There Was You’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Money (That’s What I Want)’ and ‘Twist And Shout’.

Page last updated: 28 August 2013

Also on this day...

  • 1976: Recording: She’s My Baby by Wings
  • 1972: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko ono for DPRO Vrijdag and The Joe Blow Show
  • 1972: Mixing: Attica State, The Luck Of The Irish, Sisters O Sisters, John Sinclair, Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day four
  • 1968: George Harrison flies to India
  • 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
  • 1964: Radio: Saturday Club
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Lathom Hall, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Aintree Institute, Liverpool
